test_title: PYST 45: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 9 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that represents the letters which when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below will complete the letter series.

T R _ _ Q T _ E W _ T _ _ W Q _ R G _ Q

options.text: D W S Q S F T W
D W S Q R F T W
D W R Q R F T W
E W R Q R F T W

solution:
**Given: **T R _ _ Q T _ E W _ T _ _ W Q _ R G _ Q

**Explanation:**

Let's check each option:

1) D W S Q S F T W → T R __**D**__ __W__ Q - T __S__ E W __Q__ - T __S__ __F__ W Q - __T__ R G __W__ Q

2) D W S Q R F T W → T R __D__ __W__ Q - T __S__ E W __Q__ - T __R__ __F__ W Q - __T__ R G __W__ Q

3) D W R Q R F T W → T R __D__ __W__ Q - T __R__ E W __Q__ - T __R__ __F__ W Q - __T__ R G __W__ Q

__
 
• Here we can see a pattern.
 
• 3rd letter of the word 'TR**D**WQ is increasing by +1.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/353b59f7969ea0adc310ea588bc5fb73be2f213c108b29a314ebec2a2b537e75.png] 

4) E W R Q R F T W → T R E__ __W__ Q - T __R__ E W __Q__ - T __R__ __F__ W Q - __T__ R G __W__ Q

Hence, ‘D W R Q R F T W’ is the correct answer.
